findings.title: Zero Semantic NLP — WCS Keyword Engine Only
findings.expected_behavior: System should detect: product type=paint, room context=sala, attribute=color gris — applying a gray color filter and surfacing interior paints for living rooms.
findings.actual_behavior: BROWSER CONFIRMED: 3,567 results returned via pure keyword bag-of-words match. No color filter auto-applied. No 'sala' (room) context parsed. No structured attribute extraction. WCS treats every word as an independent search token — no semantic layer present. URL: homedepot.com.mx/s/pintura+para+sala+color+gris
findings.impact_stat: 48.59% of 12.5M monthly visits arrive via organic search — 6M+ users/month searching on WCS native with no NLP. "Impermeabilizante" ↑55%, "ferreteria" ↑55% in organic — category-intent queries WCS cannot interpret.
findings.prospect_description: When a DIY customer types 'pintura para sala color gris,' they get 3,567 results in random order — no color filter applied, no room-type context. The search engine doesn't understand what they need. Customers scroll past hundreds of irrelevant products or abandon.
findings.algolia_solution: Algolia NeuralSearch understands project intent and natural language — matching 'pintura para sala color gris' to gray interior paints via semantic vector search + attribute extraction (color=gris, aplicación=interior).
findings.algolia_case_study_company: Leroy Merlin Brasil (ADEO Group — same vertical, same competitor parent)
findings.algolia_case_study_result: +31% CTR, +15% add-to-cart, +$28M estimated annual revenue after migrating from Elasticsearch to Algolia AI Search

findings.title: Typo Tolerance: Accent-Only — Edit-Distance Typos Return Zero Results
findings.expected_behavior: Should recognize 'martilo' as a typo of 'martillo' (hammer) and return carpenter hammers with a 'did you mean' correction.
findings.actual_behavior: BROWSER CONFIRMED: 'martilo de carpintero' (missing one 'l') → ZERO results. Dead-end page with generic tips only: 'Intenta buscar productos por su nombre, marca, modelo.' No 'did you mean martillo.' No alternative products suggested. WCS accent normalization worked for 'taladro inalabrico' (missing accent → 71 results) but edit-distance / phonetic typos like missing letters return zero.
findings.impact_stat: Typo failures compound a 54.23% bounce rate. Mobile-first site (79.32% mobile) with no typo tolerance = users mistype on mobile keyboard, hit zero results, bounce. Each 1% bounce reduction at 12.5M monthly visits = 125,000 more engaged sessions.
findings.prospect_description: A customer typing 'martilo de carpintero' on a mobile keyboard with autocorrect off sees a blank dead-end page. At 250M annual visits with 65% mobile traffic, edit-distance typos are the majority of typo patterns — WCS only handles accent normalization, missing the larger failure mode.
findings.algolia_solution: Algolia's built-in typo tolerance handles 1–2 character edit-distance errors automatically including missing letters, transpositions, and phonetic variants — with configurable per-language rules for Spanish diacritics.
findings.algolia_case_study_result: +37% increase in conversion rate after implementing Algolia with typo tolerance

findings.title: Poor SAYT — Low-Quality Category Fragments, No Product Previews
findings.expected_behavior: Should show predictive query suggestions (taladros, taladro inalámbrico, taladro de impacto) plus top product previews as user types.
findings.actual_behavior: BROWSER CONFIRMED: 'ta' (2 chars) returns: ['Tas', 'Tas manuales', 'Ta cerámica', 'Ta cerámica taffy', 'Tas para mecánico', 'A data', 'Acentos de las fiestas', 'Aceros y puertas santa rosa']. These are WCS category tree node fragments — not merchandised query suggestions. No product previews in dropdown. No trending queries. Empty state (on focus with no typing) shows 4 editorial product cards (Ryobi, KitchenAid, DeWalt, Midea) — not algorithmically trending, just WCS espots.
findings.impact_stat: 54.23% bounce rate vs 40% home improvement benchmark — 14.23pp excess bounce. At 12.5M monthly visits, excess bounce = ~1.78M wasted sessions/month. SAYT keeps users in discovery flow instead of bouncing.
findings.prospect_description: As a customer begins typing 'ta' expecting to see 'taladro inalámbrico,' they get 'Tas' and 'Ta cerámica taffy' — WCS category fragments that bear no resemblance to product intent. The SAYT is noise, not signal. 250M annual sessions generate no trending query data because WCS has no query analytics layer.
findings.algolia_solution: Algolia Query Suggestions + InstantSearch SAYT panel delivers trending queries, recent searches, and top products by category — turning the search box into an active revenue channel powered by real session data.
findings.algolia_case_study_result: +50% search conversion rate boost after deploying Algolia with predictive search and improved product discovery

findings.title: Regional Synonym Blind Spot — 'Grifo' Returns No Plumbing Results
findings.expected_behavior: Should map 'grifo' (colloquial Mexican Spanish for faucet/tap, equivalent to 'llave de agua' or 'canilla') to the plumbing category and return faucets, valves, and water fixtures.
findings.actual_behavior: BROWSER CONFIRMED: 'grifo' → 80 results returned, but ZERO plumbing / llave de agua results. WCS returns products with 'grifo' literally in the product name/description — not a synonym mapping. The URL is homedepot.com.mx/s/grifo. Regional Mexican Spanish synonym completely unsupported. Customers who use colloquial terms instead of catalog terminology see irrelevant results.
findings.impact_stat: CVR is 0.2% vs 1.5% industry benchmark. Zero-results on "oferta", "martilo", campaign-intent queries = dead ends for 48.59% organic search visitors. No-results recovery alone could recover 1–2pp of the 7.5x CVR gap.
findings.prospect_description: In Mexico, many consumers say 'grifo' instead of 'llave de agua' (faucet). When they search 'grifo' on HD Mexico's site, they get 80 results — none of which are plumbing fixtures. This is a complete merchandising failure for a major product category, caused by WCS having no synonym dictionary.
findings.algolia_solution: Algolia Synonyms allow merchandising teams to map 'grifo' → 'llave de agua' without engineering. Regional Spanish variants, brand names, and colloquial terms can all be configured via the no-code merchandising dashboard.
findings.algolia_case_study_result: +7% overall conversion rate improvement after deploying Algolia with intent-aware search and dynamic merchandising

findings.title: Latency — 4-5s Next.js Hydration Before Results Render
findings.expected_behavior: Search results should appear in <200ms from keystroke to first result (Algolia global SLA of <10ms P99).
findings.actual_behavior: BROWSER CONFIRMED: Searching 'herramientas electricas' (1,265 products) — Next.js SPA requires 4-5 seconds of React hydration after Enter before results render. URL: homedepot.com.mx/s/herramientas+electricas. WCS REST API at /search/resources/api/v2/products is a server-side compute call, not edge-cached at query time. Akamai mPulse RUM active and collecting real user timing data internally, but search response is not sub-100ms.
findings.impact_stat: A 100ms delay in search response time corresponds to approximately 1% reduction in revenue; 39% of shoppers leave a site if it is too slow

touches.subject: 250 millones de visitas anuales. "Oferta" = cero resultados. El costo de esa brecha.
touches.body:
Erika — Pepe Rodriguez dijo en febrero 2025 que homedepot.com.mx recibe 250 millones de visitas al año y es el sexto sitio retail más visitado de México. Con esos números, la calidad del buscador no es un tema de UX — es un palanca de ingresos.

Una sola componente del modelo que construí: si el 5% de las sesiones de búsqueda mensuales terminan en cero resultados (y en nuestra auditoría observamos "oferta", "martilo de carpintero" y "martillo bimetalico quantum" como ejemplos en vivo), y Algolia recupera el 70% de esas sesiones con resultados relevantes, el impacto conservador es del orden de $3.9M USD anuales — solo de esa componente.

El modelo completo tiene seis componentes (conversión, AOV, bounce, cero resultados, velocidad, long-tail). Escenario conservador total: $10M/año. Escenario moderado: $19M/año. Cada supuesto está marcado como [ESTIMADO] y puede ser reemplazado con tus datos reales de GA4 o Quantum Metric para afinar la cifra.

touches.video_script:
**Target viewer:** Erika Díaz (VP Online Sales), Pepe Rodriguez (President)
**Duration target:** 2 minutes / 120 seconds
**Word count target:** 200-280 words
**Delivery pace:** 120-140 words per minute

---

## HOOK (0–10 sec)

"Pasé 30 minutos en homedepot.com.mx y encontré tres cosas que me sorprendieron — y que creo que tú también necesitas ver."

*(Speaker note: open on homedepot.com.mx homepage — screenshot 01-homepage.png visible. Keep energy matter-of-fact, not salesy.)*

---

## DEMO (10–90 sec)

**Finding 1: "Oferta" = Cero Resultados (10–35 sec)**

*(Show screenshot: `19-banners-oferta.png`)*

"El primer test: escribí 'oferta' — la palabra con más intención de compra en retail mexicano, especialmente en Hot Sale. El buscador actual de IBM WebSphere Commerce devuelve cero resultados. Cero. Sin sugerencias, sin recuperación, sin ningún producto. El cliente abandona la página."

*(Speaker note: pause 1 second on the zero-results screen before moving on.)*

**Finding 2: NLP falla en consultas naturales (35–65 sec)**

*(Show screenshot: `13-nlp-pintura-gris.png`)*

"Segundo test: 'pintura para sala color gris' — exactamente como un cliente real lo escribiría. El resultado: 3,567 productos sin filtrar por color, sin entender la intención de 'sala', sin estructura. El motor trata cada palabra como una keyword suelta. El cliente ve una avalancha de resultados irrelevantes y se va."

*(Speaker note: linger on the 3,567 results count — it signals volume without relevance.)*

**Finding 3: Dead-end sin recuperación (65–90 sec)**

*(Show screenshot: `07-no-results-quantum.png`)*

"Tercer test: 'martillo bimetalico quantum' — una búsqueda específica de producto. Cero resultados, sin sugerencias de 'quisiste decir', sin productos relacionados, sin ningún camino de recuperación. El cliente llega a una página muerta."

*(Speaker note: this is the exit-intent moment — emphasize there is zero recovery path.)*

---

## BUSINESS FRAME (90–110 sec)

"Tres brechas. homedepot.com.mx recibe 250 millones de visitas al año — es el sexto sitio retail más visitado de México, en palabras del propio Pepe Rodriguez. A esa escala, un motor de búsqueda que no entiende 'oferta' ni 'pintura para sala' tiene un costo medible. El modelo conservador que construí está en el rango de $10M USD anuales."

*(Speaker note: reference to Pepe's own stat adds credibility — it's their number, not ours.)*

---

## CTA (110–120 sec)

"Armé un análisis completo con 20 queries, los datos financieros, y el contexto competitivo de LATAM. Con gusto lo reviso contigo en 15 minutos. [Tu nombre], [Tu cargo], Algolia."
